sequence.title: The Encounter
sequence.objective: Establish atmosphere, character and tension; plant the lit city, the trace-cursed-energy read, and Gojo's perch.
sequence.logic: Geography first: the aerial plants west = lit city + sunset (screen-left) and east = dark towers (screen-right) before any character appears. Thragg's arrival is an announcement (heavy, not massive, tier). His survey ends on the lights, which are his leverage (T1-19), and the cut reveals Gojo standing literally in that line. Mutual assessment in two halves: Thragg classifies an obstacle (S1-05). Gojo's Six Eyes plant R1, a civilian-level trace on an absurdly dense body, and R5, location without intent (S1-06); he peeks with one bare eye and drops the blindfold back, arrogance that Seq 3 cashes in (S1-07). Two lines; Gojo's lazy step onto the arm puts him further in the way and lands him on the boundary position. Silence intercut on both. Thragg ends the talk the way he ends everything: without warning (S1-10). Infinity is deliberately never visualised in Seq 1, so Seq 2 introduces it cold. Beat timings sit within the +/-1.5 s slack to give the dialogue its 9-frames-per-word room.
sequence.music_cue: Low string drone on D, distant restrained choir, wind; solitary taiko on the landing (S1-02 f16); near-silence for the exchange (drop_out S1-08 f0); FULL silence for the final beat before the launch (S1-09 f58 through S1-10); the sonic crack breaks it.
sequence.state_out: Gojo: on the west mast arm, x=-6, y=6.2, facing east, blindfold, no injuries. Thragg: launching from x=0 toward Gojo, facing west, cape full, no injuries. Env: landing crater at x=0 with radial cracks; storefront glass burst.

shots.camera: Aerial crane-down: the camera faces north, tilted about 35 degrees down, and sinks from about 420 m (inside the cloud base) to about 60 m over the intersection with an ease-out. No pan, no roll.
shots.screen_direction: Establishes the film's geography: camera faces north; the lit city and sunset are screen-left (west), the dark towers and the unfinished tower screen-right (east). The falling speck drops dead vertical at frame centre onto x=0.
shots.staging: Camera centre x=-30 -> x=-8, y=420 -> 60, animatic zoom 2.6 -> 14 (about 740 m -> 137 m wide), ease-out. Intersection centre x=0 at lower centre; mast at x=-7 (top y=6.4); east block x=+20..+60; unfinished tower x=+80..+110 (176 m, crane) at right; river and lit city (lit-city layer, x < -260 at d=8) at frame-left. Gojo is on the mast at (-7, 6.4) but sub-pixel. Thragg: speck at x=0 enters frame-top at f122 (y~99) and is at y~70 at the cut, falling at about 100 m/s.
shots.action: f0-30: the camera sinks through the ragged underside of the storm deck; cloud tatters stream past the lens. f30-70: the district resolves below: dark, evacuated towers with shattered windows; the wide, empty intersection at centre with the bent traffic-light mast on its west corner; screen-left, across the river, the LIT city glitters under a smouldering sunset; screen-right, dark towers and the unfinished tower with its yellow crane. f36-37: sheet lightning flickers inside the clouds (thunder arrives f44). f70-120: the crane-down eases toward the street; tarps and curtains flap from broken windows; a sheet of dust and paper slides right to left (east wind) across the empty crosswalks. f122-135: a tiny dark speck with a fleck of crimson enters frame-top, falling dead vertical toward the intersection centre (Thragg). Gojo is already on the mast but sub-pixel; nothing is featured.
shots.animatic_caption: Storm-dark dusk. Evacuated district; lit city across the river (west). A speck falls.
shots.prompt_core: Extreme wide aerial at dusk, the camera sinking north-facing through the underside of a storm-dark cloud deck. Below: an evacuated metropolitan district of dark glass towers with shattered windows, a wide empty four-way intersection at centre with crosswalk stripes and a bent traffic-light mast on its left corner. Far left, across a river, a populated city glows with thousands of lit windows beneath a smouldering orange sunset bleeding under the clouds. Right: dark towers and an unfinished skyscraper topped by a yellow tower crane. Sheet lightning flickers inside the clouds. Tarps and curtains flap from broken windows; a sheet of dust and loose paper slides across the empty intersection. In the final second a tiny dark speck with a fleck of crimson falls straight down toward the intersection.
shots.animation_notes: Camera move on 1s with an ease-out: fast through the cloud, settling as the district resolves. Clouds and haze as 3-4 parallax layers drifting east to west. Lightning is a 2-frame flicker (f36-37) inside the cloud, never a bolt to the ground; thunder lands 8 frames later at f44 to sell distance. Wind-blown tarps and paper on 2s. Gojo is physically on the mast throughout but sub-pixel: do not draw or feature him. The speck is Thragg: a 2-4 px dark fleck with one crimson glint, falling dead vertical, f122-135, no wobble. For the animatic, the lit city sits in the d>=5 layers at frame-left; it only enters frame at zoom <= 30, which this shot satisfies.

shots.action: f0-13: the empty intersection from asphalt level, crosswalk stripes leading to the centre, dust drifting right to left; a falling whistle rises; f10-13 loose paper lifts as the air pushed ahead of him arrives. f14-15: two smear drawings: Thragg streaks in from frame-top, feet first, arms tight to his body, cape streaming upward. f16 CONTACT (one-frame impact hold, small white flash): the asphalt caves into a crater about 4 m across around his boots as his knees fold deep to absorb the drop. f16-24: radial cracks race outward. f17-40: a ground-hugging dust ring rolls out toward the lens. f20-32: storefront windows on the far side burst outward in staggered, glittering sheets. f16-21: camera shake. f40-62: the dust thins to reveal him in a compact crouch, head bowed, hands loose; no fist on the ground, no pose. f44-72: the crimson cape, thrown upward at contact, settles heavily over his back. f72-85: total stillness while grit patters down.
shots.animatic_caption: Thragg drops straight down into the intersection: crater, dust ring, storefront glass bursts.
shots.prompt_core: Worm's-eye shot from the asphalt, crosswalk stripes leading to the centre of an empty intersection, dark storefronts beyond. Thragg drops vertically into frame feet first, arms close to his body, his crimson cape streaming upward like a flame, and lands dead centre. The asphalt caves into a shallow crater, radial cracks race outward, a ring of grey dust hugs the ground and rolls toward the lens, and the storefront windows behind burst outward one after another in glittering sheets. Brief camera shake. As the dust thins he is revealed in a deep, compact crouch, head bowed, hands loose, no fist on the ground. The cape drifts down and settles over his back. Absolute stillness.

tactical.intent: Arrive at the centre of the district with no wasted motion; a hard landing that announces him and invites any defender to show himself.
tactical.read: Nothing moves: the district is evacuated and dark.
tactical.outcome: Crater, radial cracks and burst storefront glass; nothing in the district answers.
tactical.learned: The people have gone. What matters lies elsewhere, and his survey will find it to the west.

shots.animation_notes: Thragg on 1s for the drop (two smear drawings f14-15); the contact drawing f16 is held one frame as the impact frame (small fr.flash, NO invert: save inverts for bigger hits). Then the crouch on 2s. The knees fold deep: the asphalt absorbs the energy, not a flourish. No three-point superhero landing, no fist on the ground. Cape: 3 frames of upward overshoot at contact, then a slow, heavy settle f44-72 on 2s. Dust ring, cracks and glass on 1s. Heavy-tier signature: star + rings + debris spray + 6 frames of shake (under 14 px). He does not look up yet.

shots.action: f0-4: hold on the crouch. f4-34: he rises slowly and levelly to full height, the camera tilting up with him; grit slides off his shoulders and the cape unfolds and hangs. f34-38: stillness; one controlled breath (f36). f38-62: one economical turn of the head, the eyes leading by two frames: from the dark towers screen-right, across the empty street, to screen-left, where his gaze settles on the distant lights of the city across the river, warm light catching the side of his face. f62-69: his shoulders follow 10-15 degrees. Cold contempt: lids half-lowered, mouth unmoving under the mustache.
shots.animatic_caption: He rises slowly. One turn of the head, cold contempt. His gaze settles west: the lit city.
shots.prompt_core: Low-angle medium shot at the crater's edge. Thragg rises slowly from the crouch to full height, the camera tilting up with him, the crimson cape hanging heavy, grit sliding off his shoulders. Upright, he is utterly still: chin level, breathing controlled. One slow, economical turn of the head carries his gaze from the dark towers on the right, across the empty street, to the left, where it stops on the distant glow of the lit city across the river, warm light catching the side of his face. Cold contempt, eyes half-lidded, mouth unmoving under the black mustache. Dust drifts past; his shoulders turn a few degrees to follow his gaze.

tactical.intent: Survey the ground for threats and for leverage.
tactical.read: Dark, empty towers; the only sign of life is the lit city across the river.
tactical.outcome: His gaze settles on the lights: a populated city is leverage (his canonical hostage tactic).
tactical.learned: The prize is west, and someone is standing in the line (revealed on the cut).

shots.animation_notes: Acting on 2s. The rise takes a full 30 frames: slow and level, no wobble, no hands on knees. Head turn is one continuous ease-in-out over 24 frames, eyes leading by 2 frames, no blink. One chest rise at f36. Contempt lives in the lids and the stillness, never a sneer. He is not searching; he is cataloguing. Use the front view for the rise, rotating to three-quarter facing screen-left for the last 8 frames.

shots.animatic_caption: Gojo, atop the bent traffic-light mast, hands in pockets, the lit city behind him. Faint smile.
shots.prompt_core: A slow crane up the bent traffic-light mast, starting on a pair of black shoes resting casually on its narrow cap high above the empty street, rising past slim dark trousers and hands pushed into jacket pockets to Gojo's face at eye level. He stands with his weight on one leg, head tilted, facing right toward the intersection below, a faint amused smile under the black blindfold. Behind him on the left horizon, across the river, the lit city glows under the smouldering sunset, warm rim light outlining his white hair and high collar against the storm sky. A gentle gust stirs his jacket hem. The street far below is dark and empty.

shots.action: ECU of Thragg's eyes and brow. f0-5: the eyes lift from the far lights, up and to the left, onto the figure on the mast. f6-14: one slow, measuring pass down and back up: build, hands, covered eyes, no weapon, no stance. f15-25: they settle and hold: flat, unblinking, unimpressed; a single exhale through the nose stirs the edge of the mustache at f16. He registered Gojo on landing and made him wait. This is classification, not discovery: an obstacle, not an equal.
shots.animatic_caption: Thragg studies him once, top to bottom. An obstacle, not an equal.
shots.prompt_core: Extreme close-up on Thragg's eyes and brow, framed tight, background a soft dusk blur. His cold dark-brown eyes lift up and to the left, finding someone above him. They make one slow, measuring pass down and back up, cataloguing, then settle and hold: flat, unblinking, unimpressed, the look one gives a locked door rather than a rival. Not a muscle in the brow moves. Warm rim light from the left glints in the eyes; one slow exhale through the nose stirs the edge of the black mustache at the bottom of frame.

tactical.intent: Classify the figure on the mast.
tactical.read: Lean, unarmoured, unarmed, hands in pockets, eyes covered, no fighting stance: no visible threat posture.
tactical.outcome: Filed as an obstacle between him and the city, not an equal.
tactical.learned: Nothing that warrants caution. Seq 2 breaks this assumption.

Crater rim (radius ~2 m) and the north storefronts traced in flow lines. Screen-space zoom x1.0 -> x1.08 f14-25 plus a 3-degree roll.
shots.action: Gojo's POV through the blindfold. f0-3: the black weave of the cloth fills frame and thins to nothing. f4-13: the Six Eyes view resolves: a deep-navy field where faint currents of residual cursed energy trace the street, crater and storefronts as thin contour lines. Thragg stands right of centre, a man-shaped mass so dense the currents crowd and bend around his outline like water around a boulder. On his skin clings only a thin, faint, flickering haze at civilian level, with no structure or flow channels inside: a trace, not zero (R1). f8: one slow, heavy heartbeat. f14-25: the view pushes in slightly and tilts 3 degrees as Gojo's head cocks in curiosity. Nothing in the haze shows intent (R5).
shots.animatic_caption: Six Eyes: a civilian-level haze of cursed energy wrapped around a body of absurd density.
shots.prompt_core: Point-of-view from high on a mast looking down-right at Thragg standing in a crater, rendered entirely as perceived through a blindfold: a dark navy field where faint currents of residual energy flow like heat haze, tracing the street, crater and storefronts as thin luminous contour lines. Thragg is a man-shaped mass so dense that the currents bunch and bend around his outline like water around a boulder. Clinging to his skin is only a thin, faint, flickering haze, as weak as an ordinary person's, with no structure inside it. The shot opens on black cloth weave thinning to transparency; the view drifts slightly closer and tilts a few degrees, curious.

tactical.intent: Gojo: read the newcomer with the Six Eyes.
tactical.read: A civilian-level trace of cursed energy wrapped around a body of absurd density; no technique, no structured flow.
tactical.outcome: He can locate Thragg, but the energy shows him no intent (R5).
tactical.learned: This body outclasses its cursed energy, a Toji-type reading problem; and the trace is real, not zero (R1).

shots.animation_notes: Screen-space treatment: desaturate to deep navy and contour-trace the environment from flow lines; Thragg's silhouette is a dense dark mass with the flow lines compressing at its edges; the haze on his skin flickers on 2s at very low intensity (fainter than any environmental residue). f0-3 cloth-weave overlay dissolving. Slow push and 3-degree roll f14-25 stand in for Gojo's head tilt. Do NOT show Infinity or any of Gojo's own energy. This is the only Six Eyes POV in the film's grammar; keep it distinct from the domain's information streams.

shots.animatic_caption: One eyebrow lifts. He hooks the blindfold up: one brilliant blue eye. Then lets it drop back.
shots.prompt_core: Medium close-up of Gojo high on a mast against the dusky sky, three-quarter view facing right and down toward the intersection. His smile fades into curiosity; one eyebrow lifts above the edge of the black blindfold. He draws his right hand from his pocket and hooks two fingers under the blindfold, lifting it a finger's width to reveal one vivid, brilliant blue eye with long white lashes, catching the dusk light and looking down at his opponent. A beat. He lets the blindfold drop back into place, slides the hand back into his pocket, and the amused smile returns, a little wider.

tactical.intent: Check the Six Eyes read with the naked eye.
tactical.read: The body confirms it: compact, heavy, utterly still, and nothing in it leaks intent.
tactical.outcome: He drops the blindfold back. Uncovering the eyes costs fatigue and this is not yet worth it.
tactical.learned: Interesting, not worrying: his canonical arrogance. Seq 3 makes him pull the blindfold down for good.

On "way" (f40-44) his eyes flick past Gojo to the city lights and back. It is literal: Gojo stands between him and the lights. f50-51: hold; the cape edge stirs in the wind.
shots.prompt_core: Low-angle close-up of Thragg in three-quarter profile facing left, looking up toward someone above him, the dark eastern towers and storm sky behind. Warm rim light from the left falls across his severe face and black mustache. Utterly still except for his mouth, he speaks one short, flat sentence.
